summary: Frontend-only regression test for DemoVideoCarousel visibility fix. Verified the section now renders on / with an empty-state placeholder card when 0 videos exist in DB. Section header, empty-state card copy, and hidden nav arrows all confirmed. Also verified /api/admin/reports regression (returns 401 unauth, NOT 500).
critical_code_review_comments: DemoVideoCarousel.jsx code is clean; conditional { videos.length === 0 ? <EmptyStateCard/> : videos.map(...) } correctly swaps empty-state for real cards when a video is uploaded — the empty-state -> real-card regression path is guaranteed by the render logic, so re-uploading a video (already verified in iteration_42) was skipped per main-agent's guidance.

Section header stale-content nit: the header still reads 'Short walkthroughs recorded by our team. Real screen, real report.' even when 0 videos exist. Considering the empty-state already says 'Coming soon' + 'First workflow clips landing here shortly.', the two messages slightly conflict. Optional: gate the header subtitle behind videos.length > 0. Not a blocker.
test_credentials: Not needed — logged-out visitor flow only. Admin regression skipped per main-agent note (already verified in iteration_42).
seed_data_creation: None. demo_videos collection remains empty as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The DemoVideoCarousel section is now permanently visible on the landing page. When admin uploads a real demo video via /admin → Demo Videos, EmptyStateCard is automatically replaced by VideoCard(s). Full CRUD for demo videos + poster upload + admin CMS was 12/12 verified in iteration_42. If admin adds a video and the empty-state persists, first check /api/demo-videos response payload.
